Law and Public Policy Minor

The minor in law and public policy draws upon four fields of study: public policy and management, law, economics and political science. It provides students with an understanding of the legal and policy process, the role of courts and nonprofit organizations in public decision making, and the legal bases for various areas of public policy.

Students minoring in law and public policy take 20 units, including the gateway class, PPD 225 Public Policy and Management, and one elective.

Required Courses

  • PPD 225 Solving Public Problems Units: 4
  • PPD 314 Public Policy and Law Units: 4
  • PPD 315 Analytic Foundations for Public Policy Units: 4
  • POSC 340 Constitutional Law Units: 4 or
  • LAW 300 Concepts in American Law Units: 4 or
  • PPD 357 Government and Business Units: 4

And one of the following:

  • FBE 403 Introduction to the Legal Environment of Business Units: 4
  • LAW 200w Law and Society Units: 4
